arStrings.szText: Thanks to you. Hey, we’re even now.
You came at a good time. Their leader—was he the one that stabbed you?—he’s personally picking out Knights for a search party. Now’s a good chance to leave, before he sets out.
I can’t let him live. Not with the threat he poses to Neyrelle. Everyone stay here—I'll handle this.
